description: Evaluates whether better training objectives (EEG augmentation + supervised contrastive loss) produce a better 32-D EEGConformer embedding. Uses the exact same corrected protocol as T-032/T-033.
protocol: LOSO (50 folds), train-only candidate pools, per-fold PCA refit, no leakage
preprocessing: 160→250 Hz resample, 22-ch BCI-IV-2a subset, bandpass 4-38 Hz, z-score per channel, 1000 samples (4s)

embedding_stability.note: stability not computed for PCA bandpower
